## Sheet

- **Player.** Maya.
- **Class, species and level.** Rogue (Thief) 3, Halfling, Criminal background.
- **Armor Class, Hit Points and Speed.** AC 14 (leather armor), 24 Hit Points, Speed 30 ft.
- **Passive Perception and save DC.** Passive Perception 13. No save DC.
- **Saving throws.** Dexterity +5, Intelligence +3, Strength -1, Constitution +2, Wisdom +1, Charisma +0.

| Str    | Dex     | Con     | Int     | Wis     | Cha     |
| ------ | ------- | ------- | ------- | ------- | ------- |
| 8 (-1) | 17 (+3) | 14 (+2) | 12 (+1) | 13 (+1) | 10 (+0) |

### Features

- **Expertise.** Stealth +7 and Sleight of Hand +7.
- **Sneak Attack.** Once per turn, 2d6 extra damage with Advantage or an ally adjacent to the target.
- **Thieves' Cant.** A secret code of signs and words.
- **Weapon Mastery.** Dagger (Nick) and shortsword (Vex).
- **Cunning Action.** Bonus action to Dash, Disengage or Hide.
- **Steady Aim.** Bonus action for Advantage on the next attack this turn, if she has not moved.
- **Fast Hands.** Cunning Action also lets her make a Sleight of Hand check, use thieves' tools to open a lock or disarm a trap, or take the Utilize action.
- **Second-Story Work.** Climb Speed equal to her Speed.
- **Halfling traits.** Brave, Halfling Nimbleness, Luck and Naturally Stealthy.
- **Alert.** Adds her Proficiency Bonus to Initiative.
- **Skills.** Perception +3, Acrobatics +5, Investigation +3, Stealth +7, Sleight of Hand +7.

## Spells

Tamsin does not cast spells.

## Inventory

- Leather armor.
- Shortsword, two daggers and a shortbow with 20 arrows.
- Thieves' tools and a burglar's pack.
- 21 gold pieces and a slip of paper with a debt written on it.

## Story

> [!narration] Portrait
> You are small even for a halfling, with quick dark eyes and ink on two fingers that never quite washes off. Your leather is old and well oiled, and the hood hangs low. You sit with your back to the wall and a clear line to the door. You hum without noticing it, and stop when someone looks at you.

### Backstory

Tamsin grew up in the Undertow of Saltwick. At nine she began carrying messages for [[Ilse Corran]], and by twelve she could copy a clerk's hand well enough to pass a forged tally. She left at fifteen after a job went wrong, and has been working the road for three years.

## Goals and bonds

- **Goal.** Clear the debt she still owes [[Ilse Corran]] so that she never has to go back to the Undertow.
- **Bond.** [[Pell Rushlight]], the goblin ferryman who let her ride free when she left Saltwick.
- **Fear.** Being owned by someone again.

## Plans

- Ilse considers Tamsin one of her own. Use a Spotlight when Ilse calls in the debt, with a job that would harm the Party.
- Tamsin can read the Vessen script better than she admits, because Ilse taught her to read old ledgers. See [[Harbormaster's Ledger of Vessen]].
